prompts.text: Draw a small imaginary creature floating in the air around you. Use at least three colors.
Draw a hot-air balloon and the sky around it.
Draw a doorway to a place you would like to visit.
Draw a tree whose leaves are any colors you like.
Draw a house in the clouds.
Draw a quiet lake with a few hills behind it.
Draw a flower garden around you, one flower at a time.
Draw a sunset over the ocean with slow, wide strokes.
Draw a forest path with a few trees on each side.
Draw clouds drifting across the sky.
Draw slow waves, one after another, breathing out with each stroke.
Draw a large spiral that slowly grows outward.
Draw rings around yourself, one slow circle at a time.
Draw falling leaves drifting slowly to the ground.
Draw a simple pattern of repeating shapes in a row.
